# shouldDisplayError

commonJvmAndroid

fun [shouldDisplayError](should-display-error.html)(error: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/latest/jvm/stdlib/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)): [Boolean](https://kotlinlang.org/api/latest/jvm/stdlib/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-boolean/index.html)

Returns true when the given non-null `error` string from a [FunctionResponse](../../../com.google.adk.kt.types/-function-response/index.html) should be surfaced to the operator. Suppresses blank values and [FunctionTool.CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED_ERROR](../../../com.google.adk.kt.tools/-function-tool/-companion/-c-o-n-f-i-r-m-a-t-i-o-n_-r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d_-e-r-r-o-r.html), which is the transient placeholder that a confirmation-gated [FunctionTool](../../../com.google.adk.kt.tools/-function-tool/index.html) returns on its first invocation - it is not a real failure (the framework re-executes the tool once the user supplies a confirmation), and printing it as "BaseTool Error" misleads the operator. Other error strings - including [FunctionTool.REJECTED_ERROR](../../../com.google.adk.kt.tools/-function-tool/-companion/-r-e-j-e-c-t-e-d_-e-r-r-o-r.html) after the user explicitly types 'no' - are still surfaced.
